title: Trilinear universal property of iterated sheaf tensor
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a site small relative to a fixed coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf on $C$, and let $A,B,T,H$ be sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $\operatorname{Trilin}_R(A,B,T;H)$ for the set of morphisms of underlying sheaves of sets $A\times B\times T\to H$ whose component over each object $U$ is $R(U)$-linear separately in each of the three variables. For the sheafified balanced tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], composition with $(x,y,z)\mapsto(x\otimes y)\otimes z$ induces a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_R((A\otimes_RB)\otimes_RT,H)\cong\operatorname{Trilin}_R(A,B,T;H)$, natural contravariantly in $A,B,T$ and covariantly in $H$. Here each pure tensor means the image under the canonical presheaf-to-sheaf tensor map. In particular two morphisms $(A\otimes_RB)\otimes_RT\to H$ are equal if and only if they agree on $(x\otimes y)\otimes z$ for every object $U$ and all $x\in A(U),y\in B(U),z\in T(U)$.

source.place: Tags 03EK (section-tensor-product), 03EO (lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor) and 04TT (section-internal-hom); agent extraction of the iterated universal property.

proof.text: Convert a restriction-compatible separately linear family beta into a curried triple linear map at each object. Apply TensorProduct.lift twice to obtain a morphism ((A tensor_p B) tensor_p T) -> H.val. Check naturality by tensor induction, with the pure-triple case exactly beta restriction compatibility. Conversely evaluate a presheaf morphism on pure triples. Tensor induction and function extensionality prove these constructions inverse.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product and lemma-sheafification-tensor; iteration of the sectionwise tensor universal property.

proof.text: Write P = A.val tensor_p B.val and eta:P -> (P#).val for the module sheafification unit. The unit is locally injective and locally surjective. Apply lem-weil-pbc-tensor-local-bijection-universes to eta tensor id_T to obtain an isomorphism L(P tensor_p T.val) -> L((P#).val tensor_p T.val), where L is module sheafification. Its target is the stated iterated sheaf tensor. Precomposition with this isomorphism followed by the sheafification adjunction identifies maps from the iterated sheaf tensor into H with maps from the presheaf triple tensor into H.val. Compose with Step 1 to obtain the desired equivalences without enlarging the coefficient universe.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product and lemma-sheafification-tensor; iteration of the sectionwise tensor universal property.

proof.text: The sheafification adjunction is natural in the source: its value on L(eta tensor id_T) followed by f is (eta tensor id_T) followed by its value on f. Evaluation on a pure triple is therefore exactly f applied to the nested canonical pure tensors, proving the first clause.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product and lemma-sheafification-tensor; iteration of the sectionwise tensor universal property.

proof.text: Naturality of the sheafification unit applied to the presheaf maps a tensor id and id tensor b shows that the two induced sheaf tensor maps send pure tensors to tensors of the images. Apply these formulas first to the outer pure tensor and then to the inner one. Together with Step 3 this proves contravariant naturality in the three inputs and covariant naturality in H.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product and lemma-sheafification-tensor; iteration of the sectionwise tensor universal property.

proof.text: Equal morphisms agree on pure triples. Conversely agreement on pure triples and Step 3 give equality of the two trilinear families. Subtype and function extensionality identify their images under the equivalence of Step 2, whose injectivity proves equality of the morphisms.
